svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Offer a carousel of selective 2-3 minute preview clips spanning genres, starting playback
on hover, so an undecided user can judge whether a show suits them without leaving Netflix
. → Keep undecided users on Netflix instead of losing them to YouTube, reducing churn.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Offer a carousel of selective 2-3 minute preview clips spanning genres, starting playback
on hover, so an undecided user can judge whether a show suits them without leaving Netflix
. → Provide a play option on a preview clip so the user can jump directly to the full show

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Keep the software experience and the recommendation engine consistent over time so the ser
vice stays familiar to the user. → Keep undecided users on Netflix instead of losing them
